name: page
title: Page foundation
description: One path-driven pages collection, typed layouts, translations, and SEO.

files.content:
---
import { render } from "astro:content"
import type { AstroComponentFactory } from "astro/runtime/server/index.js"

import type { Page } from "@/lib/pages"
import OverviewLayout from "@/layouts/overview.astro"
import PageLayout from "@/layouts/page.astro"

type Props = Page
const page = Astro.props
const { Content } = await render(page)

// Every page type needs a layout here; the schema union and this map move together.
const layouts = { page: PageLayout, overview: OverviewLayout } satisfies Record<
  Page["data"]["type"],
  AstroComponentFactory
>
const Layout = layouts[page.data.type]
---

<Layout page={page}><Content /></Layout>

--- import type { Page } from "@/lib/pages" import Base from "./base.astro" type Props = { page: Page } const { page } = Astro.props ---

{page.data.title}

{page.data.description}

import { type SchemaContext } from "astro:content"
import { z } from "astro/zod"

import { imageSchema, seoSchema } from "@/schemas/shared"

export const baseSchema = (ctx: SchemaContext) =>
  z.object({
    title: z.string().trim().min(1),
    description: z.string().trim().min(1),
    translationKey: z.string().trim().min(1).optional(),
    updatedAt: z.coerce.date().optional(),
    image: imageSchema(ctx).optional(),
    seo: seoSchema(ctx).optional(),
  })

export type BaseSchema = z.infer<ReturnType<typeof baseSchema>>

import { reference, type SchemaContext } from "astro:content"
import { z } from "astro/zod"

import { baseSchema } from "@/schemas/layouts/base"

export const overviewSchema = (ctx: SchemaContext) =>
  baseSchema(ctx)
    .extend({ entries: z.array(reference("pages")).optional() })
    .strict()

export type OverviewSchema = z.infer<ReturnType<typeof overviewSchema>>

import type { SchemaContext } from "astro:content"
import { z } from "astro/zod"

import { baseSchema } from "@/schemas/layouts/base"
import { overviewSchema } from "@/schemas/layouts/overview"

export const pageSchema = (ctx: SchemaContext) =>
  z.discriminatedUnion("type", [
    baseSchema(ctx)
      .extend({ type: z.literal("page") })
      .strict(),
    overviewSchema(ctx).extend({ type: z.literal("overview") }),
  ])

import { type SchemaContext } from "astro:content"
import { z } from "astro/zod"

export const linkSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string(),
  href: z.string(),
})

export const buttonSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string(),
  href: z.string(),
  icon: z.string().optional(),
  variant: z.enum(["default", "outline", "secondary", "ghost"]).optional(),
})

export const imageSchema = ({ image }: SchemaContext) =>
  z.object({
    src: image(),
    alt: z.string(),
  })

export const seoSchema = (ctx: SchemaContext) =>
  z
    .object({
      title: z.string().trim().min(1).optional(),
      description: z.string().trim().min(1).optional(),
      image: imageSchema(ctx).optional(),
      canonical: z.url().optional(),
      noindex: z.boolean().optional(),
      nofollow: z.boolean().optional(),
    })
    .strict()
